 Our client is a leading organisation operating within a secure and technically complex environment and is seeking to engage a DevSecOps Engineer on a permanent basis. Working as part of a collaborative engineering team, you will contribute to the delivery and sustainment of modern software development platforms, automation capabilities and secure infrastructure that support critical business outcomes.   This role is based in Brisbane and requires a commitment to working onsite 4-5 days per week. Due to the nature of the environment, this position cannot be performed remotely. Brisbane-based candidates are strongly preferred, however applications are welcomed from interstate candidates who are genuinely committed to relocating. Joining a collaborative engineering team, you will contribute to the delivery and sustainment of modern software development platforms, automation capabilities and secure infrastructure supporting critical business outcomes.  An NV2 Security Clearance is highly desirable. We also encourage applications from candidates who hold NV1 or Baseline clearances, or Australian Citizens who are eligible and willing to obtain a security clearance. 
   Your new role     
 As a DevSecOps Engineer, you will play a key role in the design, implementation and ongoing support of secure software development environments and CI/CD pipelines. Working alongside engineering, infrastructure and security teams, you will help drive automation, improve platform performance and ensure development environments remain secure, scalable and compliant.   
  Key responsibilities:   
 
 Designing, implementing and maintaining secure CI/CD pipelines 
 Supporting and optimising secure software development environments 
 Deploying, configuring and maintaining Kubernetes and Docker platforms 
 Developing and supporting GitLab CI/CD workflows and integrations 
 Managing Linux and Windows-based development environments 
 Building and maintaining Ansible automation and configuration management solutions 
 Troubleshooting platform, infrastructure and application issues 
 Producing and maintaining technical documentation and configuration records 
 Supporting ongoing platform maintenance, upgrades and continuous improvement activities 
 
  What you'll need to succeed     
 To be successful, you will bring proven experience within DevSecOps, platform engineering or infrastructure automation environments, along with a strong focus on security, reliability and operational excellence. 
   
  Key requirements:  
 
 CI/CD pipeline design, implementation and support 
 GitLab administration and pipeline development 
 Kubernetes and Docker environments 
 Ansible and Infrastructure as Code methodologies 
 Linux administration, particularly Ubuntu and Red Hat 
 Secure software development environments and DevSecOps practices 
 Technical troubleshooting and performance optimisation 
 Documentation, change management and governance processes 
 
  Highly desirable:  
 
 Defence, government or other highly regulated environments 
 Security governance and compliance frameworks 
 Certifications such as Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), RHCSA or similar 
 Tertiary qualifications in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cyber Security or a related discipline 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Exposure to modern DevSecOps, automation and cloud-native technologies 
 The opportunity to work within a secure and technically advanced environment 
 A collaborative team culture that values innovation, continuous improvement and technical excellence 
 Long-term career development and professional growth opportunities 
 
  What you need to do now     If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now. Located in: located in the peaceful surrounds of Auchenflower, The Wesley Hospital is just 5 mins from Toowong Shopping Village and 10 mins from Brisbane City - public transport easily accessible at the foot of the hospital. Subsidised parking available.

Make a meaningful difference with The Wesley Private Hospital 

The Wesley Hospital is one of Australia's iconic and largest private not-for-profit hospitals. From the heart of Brisbane, more than 800 Visiting Medical Practitioners and 2,000 staff deliver personalised care through life's journey making a meaningful difference in the lives of generations of Queenslanders. We offer comprehensive care across a wide range of acute tertiary-level medical and surgical services with a particular focus on cancer care, cardiac care, women's and children's care, and complex surgical care. This includes the busiest robotic surgery program and the first Robotic Surgery Centre of Excellence accredited in Australia. 

An integral part of our team, as a Security Officer, you'll be encouraged to grow, develop and feel empowered to make the everyday easier for the people we care so passionately about. Let's make a meaningful difference, together! 

Your part in The Wesley Hospital team 

We are searching for experienced hospital-based Security and Emergency Response team members for The Wesley Hospital, you will be responsible for providing a secure environment for staff, visitors and patients.

A previous background in a similar type of workplace is essential, holding a current Queensland Class 1 Security Provider Licence with endorsements in Security Officer Unarmed, Crowd Control and Monitoring.

A hands-on role, key responsibilities and duties will include:

Operating the Security-Fire services Monitor room

Issuing Identification Cards and maintain the employee data file

Operational of fire indicator panels and EWIS system . Responding to fire alarms and emergency codes in accordance with AS 4083-2010' Emergency Planning in Healthcare Facilities and AS 3745-2010' Planning for Emergencies in Facilities

Providing an escort service for visitors and staff within the Hospital campus

Locking and patrolling the Hospital complex and all parking areas

Investigating security related incidents, ensuring detailed and accurate reports are completed

Responding to complaints and inquiries from staff and visitors, whilst adopting a customer service approach at all times

Monitoring and responding to plant and equipment faults

Identifying risks and recommending improvements for the safety of staff, patients and visitors

Promoting and maintaining security awareness amongst staff members

Performing general administrative duties

Operating high volume car park management systems

If coming from another industry with transferable skills, applications will be considered as long as the relevant licences are available for review.

Highly desirable experience in hospital-based security and emergency response.

Minimum 3 years' experience in security related employment

Certificate II in Security Operations or above

Advanced computer skills including MS Office and security-car park applications

Flexibility to work rotational shifts of 12-hours, including nights and weekends

A current manual open driver's license

Ability to work in a busy Control Room environment

Beneficial to have hospital required vaccinations to speed up your onboarding process.

Covering Letter - Maximum of two pages relating your experience and skill sets and how these align to the position description.

Resume - Including clear reference to your Security Providers Licence number and functions.

NFP Salary Packaging: Save tax and increase your take home pay by salary packaging your everyday living expenses and bills (up to $15,900) and meal entertainment (up to $2,650) per annum. To learn more about this benefit watch the video via the following link: Salary Packaging Explained

12 weeks paid parental leave and 2 weeks paid partner leave, available after 6 months service, in addition to the government scheme

Career development opportunities to challenge yourself, grow and make a meaningful difference 

A positive and inclusive team based on respect, shared standards, strong values and a commitment to serving others 

We'd love you to be part of our UnitingCare family 

By joining our Hospitals, you'll also be welcomed as part of the UnitingCare family. The second-largest Queensland employer, we're a proud not-for-profit with more than 17,500 staff and 9, 000 volunteers across our brands of BlueCare, Lifeline, ARRCS, The Wesley Hospital, Buderim Private Hospital, St Stephen's Hospital, and St Andrew's War Memorial Hospital, and have been leading by example for more than 100 years. result.description:
We are searching for experienced hospital based Security and Emergency Response team members for The Wesley Hospital, you will be responsible for providing a secure environment for staff, visitors and patients.
A previous background in a similar type of workplace is essential, holding a current Queensland Class 1 Security Provider Licence with endorsements in Security Officer Unarmed, Crowd Control and Monitoring.
A hands on role, key responsibilities and duties will include
Operating the Security/Fire services Monitor room
Issuing Identification Cards and maintain the employee data file
Operational of fire indicator panels and EWIS system  Responding to fire alarms and emergency codes in accordance with AS 4083 2010 Emergency Planning in Healthcare Facilities and AS 3745 2010 Planning for Emergencies in Facilities
Providing an escort service for visitors and staff within the Hospital campus
Locking and patrolling the Hospital complex and all parking areas
Investigating security related incidents, ensuring detailed and accurate reports are completed
Responding to complaints and inquiries from staff and visitors, whilst adopting a customer service approach at all times
Monitoring and responding to plant and equipment faults
Identifying risks and recommending improvements for the safety of staff, patients and visitors
Promoting and maintaining security awareness amongst staff members
Performing general administrative duties
Operating high volume car park management systems
If coming from another industry with transferable skills, applications will be considered as long as the relevant licences are available for review.
